━━━ group.welcome ━━━
Hello everyone! You can now play the game right here in this group; send "profile" or "help" to begin.
Crime and jail happen in the group; your money, bank, travel and settings stay private, in your chat with the bot.

━━━ group.make_admin ━━━
🛠 Group admins: to make words like "crime" and "profile" work without "/", make the bot an admin of this group. Until then, send commands with "/".

━━━ group.not_yours ━━━
This button belongs to another player. Send the command yourself to open your own screen.

━━━ group.sent_privately ━━━
Your reply was sent to your private chat with the bot.

━━━ group.start_bot_first ━━━
This screen is for you only. Open the bot in a private chat and press Start first, and it will be shown there.

━━━ group.open_bot ━━━
Open the bot
